## Professional profile

Structural biologist and proteomics researcher with experience spanning protein biochemistry, structural biology, cross-linking mass spectrometry, post-translational modification analysis, and computational structural biology. My research integrates experimental and computational approaches to investigate protein structure, molecular interactions, regulatory modifications, and cellular function.

**Contact:** [youngki.you.research@gmail.com](mailto:youngki.you.research@gmail.com)

## Research appointments

### Pacific Northwest National Laboratory
**Postdoctoral Research Associate, Biological Sciences Division**  
2022–2026

Research focused on integrative structural proteomics, protein–protein interactions, post-translational modifications, protein biochemistry, and computational analysis across diverse biological systems.

### University of Houston
**Postdoctoral Fellow**  
2021

**Graduate Research Assistant**  
2015–2020

Research focused on the structural and functional regulation of Munc13-1 and related signaling proteins using recombinant protein biochemistry, NMR, X-ray crystallography, cell-based assays, molecular docking, and molecular dynamics simulations.

### Handong Global University
**Graduate Research Assistant / Research Assistant**  
2006–2014

Conducted computational and experimental studies involving protein sequence analysis, structural modeling, molecular docking, and biological applications of protein and peptide systems.
